2.3.27 Report.TopMargin
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Report.TopMargin element specifies the height of the top margin of a Report. The
Report.TopMargin element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If
this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "0in".
Following is the parent element of the Report.TopMargin element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.TopMargin element.
 <xsd:element name="TopMargin" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
